notes.subject: plei pasin narapela
notes.rationale: ינכר literally 'make oneself unrecognized/foreign' — dissembles with his lips; rendered as playing a different person.

notes.subject: שונא / ישית מרמה
notes.rationale: Contrast of outer lips vs inner heart continues the potsherd-veneer image of v23; chiasm of speech-outside / deceit-inside.

translation: Long lep bilong en, man i birua i save plei pasin narapela, tasol long insait bel bilong en em i putim giaman.

tokens.gloss: tasol long insait bel bilong en
